x-m-el-cul-01.title: Ingabe ikhadi lesikweletu ngempela "isilinganiso segolide"?
x-m-el-cul-01.topic: Isilinganiso, ukulingana, namaphethini ezobuciko nasempilweni yansuku zonke
x-m-el-cul-01.goal: Bala izilinganiso bese uzaqhathanisa nesimangalo, bese umisa isiqinisekiso sakho sokuthi umehluko ongakanani ovunyelwe ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amagama athi "kungu-isilinganiso segolide."
x-m-el-cul-01.material: Ibhulogi inalo musho: 'Ikhadi lesikweletu liyi-rectangle engu-85.6mm ngo-53.98mm, enesilinganiso sohlangothi olude kuya kohlangothi olufushane okungu-isilinganiso segolide.' Isilinganiso segolide singu-(1 kanye nempande yesikwele ka-5) ohlukaniswe ngo-2, okungukuthi, cishe 1.618. Osayizi (uhlangothi olude : uhlangothi olufushane) bamacala okuqhathanisa nanku. Iphepha le-A4 297mm : 210mm, ikhadi leposi 148mm : 100mm, nesikrini se-monitor esinesilinganiso esingu-16 kuya ku-10, 16 : 10.
x-m-el-cul-01.prereq.0: Ukuthola isilinganiso sobude obubili ngokuhlukanisa (izinga lesikole esiphakeme)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukuhlola umusho webhulogi othi 'Ikhadi lesikweletu liyi-rectangle yesilinganiso segolide.' Hlukanisa uhlangothi olude ngohlangothi olufushane bese ukhetha ukuhlolwa okungcono.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa uhlangothi olude ngohlangothi olufushane bese ubeka leli nani eduze no-1.618.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ngokwehlukile ukuthi amanani amabili alingana yini nokuthi ahluka kangakanani.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.a: Isiphumo 1.586 siqoqwa sibe ngu-1.6, ngakho ungasho ukuthi ngokuphelele kungu-isilinganiso segolide
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzisa inani eliqoqwe ukuze libukeke lifana njengobufakazi be-"kulingana." Hlola ukuthi isiphetho sishintsha ngokuya ngokuthi uqoqa kumadijithi amangaki.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.b: 1.586 no-1.618 kuhlukile, ngakho ikhadi lesikweletu alinakho ukuhlobana nesilinganiso segolide nhlobo
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.b: Uhlukanisa kube ngu-"kulingana / akunjalo nhlobo" kuphela. Awucabangelanga ukuthi umehluko mkhulu kangakanani.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.c: Isilinganiso singu-1.586 cishe, esihlukile ku-1.618, ngakho u-'kusondele' ligama elinembile
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.c: Uqhathanise inani elibaliwe nenani esimangalweni, futhi wahlukanisa u-'kulingana' no-'kusondele'.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.d: Isilinganiso esilinganiswe ngama-mm siyashintsha uma siguqulelwa kuma-cm, ngakho amanani awakwazi ukuqhathaniswa
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.d: Ucabanga ukuthi isilinganiso siyashintsha uma iyunithi ishintsha. Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani esilinganisweni sobude obubili obulinganiswe ngeyunithi efanayo uma iyunithi iguqulwa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.explain: 85.6÷53.98 ungu-1.586 cishe, ohluka kusilinganiso segolide 1.618 ngo-2% cishe. Ecaleni elinje, "kusondele esilinganisweni segolide" yimibono eqotho, kunokuthi "kungu-isilinganiso segolide ngokuphelele."
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.prompt: Umise isiqinisekiso: 'Uma uhlangothi olude ÷ uhlangothi olufushane luhluka ku-1.618 ngaphakathi kuka-3%, lusondele esilinganisweni segolide.' Khetha wonke amacala angabizwa ngokuthi asondele. (3% ka-1.618 ungu-0.049 cishe.)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.0: Guqula isilinganiso secala ngalinye sibe yidesimali.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khipha u-0.049 ku-1.618 bese wengeza u-0.049 kuwo ukuthola ibanga elivunyelwe wena uqobo, bese uhlola ukuthi isilinganiso ngasinye siwela ngaphakathi kwalo yini.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.a: Hlola futhi ukuthi ufunde kanjani umehluko esinyathelweni sokuthola isilinganiso nokuqhathanisa nesiqinisekiso. Bala ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwalelo nani no-1.618 ungaphakathi kwebanga elivunyelwe yini.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.b: Uthole isilinganiso futhi waqhathanisa umehluko no-1.618 nebanga elivunyelwe.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.c: Hlola ukuthi ubale wena ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwesilinganiso sekhadi leposi no-1.618 ungaphakathi kwebanga elivunyelwe yini. Umuzwa wokuthi kubukeka kufana ngamehlo uhlukile ekuqhathaniseni nesiqinisekiso.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.d: Uguqule u-16÷10 waba yidesimali futhi waqhathanisa nesiqinisekiso.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.explain: Ikhadi lesikweletu kuphela, 1.586 (umehluko we-2.0% cishe), ne-monitor, 1.6 (1.1% cishe), ziphakathi kuka-3%. I-A4 ingu-1.414 cishe (12.6% cishe) futhi ikhadi leposi lingu-1.48 (8.5% cishe), ngaphandle kwebanga.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.prompt: Ukubekezelela (lapha ku-3%) kuyisiqinisekiso engisimisile. Bhala emshweni o-1 noma emibili ukuthi kungani kufanele umise ukubekezelela ngaphambi kokusho ukuthi "kungu-isilinganiso segolide," nokuthi yini okufanele uqaphele uma umisa isiqinisekiso.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala bhala emshweni o-1 ukuthi kungani isinqumo esenziwe ngaphandle kwesiqinisekiso siyinkinga.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani ku-A4 nekhadi leposi uma umisa isiqinisekiso sibe sikhulu kakhulu (isibonelo, 20%).
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unike njengesizathu ukuthi u-"inani elifanayo ngokuphelele" cishe alikho empeleni?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi kwenzekani uma isiqinisekiso sikhulu kakhulu noma sincane kakhulu?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ukuthi ikhadi lesikweletu nekhadi leposi lihlukana kanjani ngaphansi kwesiqinisekiso sakho?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.0: Amanani alinganisiwe njalo anephutha futhi amarula awalungile ngokuphelele, ngakho amanani alingana ngokuphelele cishe awekho. Ngakho kufanele kuqala umise ukubekezelela okunjengo-1% noma u-3%, bese usho ukuthi kusondele uma kungaphakathi kwalokho. Uma umisa isiqinisekiso sikhulu kakhulu, cishe wonke ama-rectangle aba isilinganiso segolide.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.1: I-rectangle engu-1.618 ngqo cishe ayikho empeleni, ngakho kufanele umise ibanga elinjengaphakathi kuka-5%. Kodwa uma wenza ibanga libe ngu-10%, ikhadi leposi (umehluko ongu-8.5% cishe) nalo liyafakwa futhi isiqinisekiso siba lukhululekile kakhulu.

x-m-el-cul-02.title: Ukuthola umugqa ongalungile etafuleni lokulingana
x-m-el-cul-02.goal: Thola futhi ulungise iphutha esixazululweni esifingqa inani lemigqa yokulingana, bese ukhetha wena ukuthi yiziphi izimo ezinemigqa yokulingana engu-2 ngqo.
x-m-el-cul-02.material: Ukulingana kuvame ukusetshenziswa emaphethini endabuko nasekuklanyweni kwezakhiwo. Umfundi wenze ithebula lifingqa ukulingana kwezimo. Isibalo esilinganayo ngomugqa sinomugqa wokulingana, umugqa lapho isibalo siqondana ngqo uma sisongwa, futhi isibalo esilinganayo ngephoyinti yisibalo esiqondana nesokuqala uma sijikwa ngengxenye yokujika (180°) ezungeze iphoyinti elithile. Omunye wemigqa etafuleni unephutha.
x-m-el-cul-02.thinking.1: Lungisa iphutha bese uchaza ukuthi ungakuhlola kanjani
x-m-el-cul-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yezibalo ezilinganayo ngomugqa (ziqondana uma zisongwa ngomugqa othile) nezibalo ezilinganayo ngephoyinti (ziqondana uma zijikwa ngo-180° ezungeze iphoyinti)

Inemigqa yokulingana engu-2 kuphela, ukusonga uhhafu ngobude nobubanzi. Ingxenye ethi iyisibalo esilinganayo ngephoyinti ilungile.

x-m-el-cul-03.title: Ukuklama iphethini yendlela ephakathi yamabhulokhi angu-100
x-m-el-cul-03.goal: Klama iziphethini eziningana eziphindaphindwayo ezihlangabezana nesilinganiso esimisiwe nezimo zobude ngasikhathi sinye, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani izikhathi ezingenzeka zinomthetho ovamile.
x-m-el-cul-03.material: Emgqeni wamabhulokhi endlela angu-100, amabhulokhi abomvu namabhulokhi aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka abekwa ngokulandelana. Iphethini ithatha u-'amabhulokhi abomvu angu-r alandelwa amabhulokhi aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka angu-(p−r)' njengeqembu e-1 futhi iphinda leli qembu. Izimo zinjena. (1) U-p yinombolo yemvelo esuka ku-2 kuya ku-50, futhi u-r yinombolo yemvelo esuka ku-1 kuze kube ngaphansi kuka-p. (2) Iqembu lokugcina alinqunyiwe, futhi amabhulokhi angu-100 aphela ngqo. (3) Kunamabhulokhi abomvu angu-40 ngqo (40% wesiyonke).

x-m-el-cul-03.s.s1.because.prompt: Amanani ka-p owathole wonke ayizicaba zenombolo muphi? Chaza ngomusho owodwa noma emibili ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka.
x-m-el-cul-03.s.s1.because.hint.0: Guqula inkulumo u-r × (inani lamaqoqo) = 40 ibe yinkulumo ka-r.
x-m-el-cul-03.s.s1.because.hint.1: Khetha izihlukanisi ezimbalwa zika-100, njengo-p=4 noma p=20, bala u-r, futhi uhlukanise amacala lapho u-r eyinombolo yemvelo nalawo lapho engeyona.
x-m-el-cul-03.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Isizathu sakho sixhumene nesilinganiso sokuthi 'amabhulokhi abomvu ayingxenye ye-2/5 yokuphelele'?
x-m-el-cul-03.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Uchaze usebenzisa icala elinjengo-'p=3, r=1.2' lapho u-r engaphenduki inombolo yemvelo?
x-m-el-cul-03.s.s1.because.model.0: Amabhulokhi abomvu angu-40% wokuphelele, okungu-2/5, ngakho amabhulokhi abomvu kufanele abe ngu-2/5 neqoqweni e-1 nakho. Ukuze u-r abe yinombolo yemvelo, u-p kufanele abe yisiphindaphindi sika-5.
